title: The pod manifest shows a base URL that the build would refuse
details:
`deploy/vcr.yaml` tells the reader to end a base URL in `/c/<name>`, and shows `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8080/c/build`.

The prefix has carried two segments since the provider became part of it. A URL with one segment is refused as `bad_prefix`, so a reader who copies the line gets a pod that serves nothing and an error naming a rule the file never mentioned.

It is the only place the old one-segment form survives.
